reviews.t: This is my favorite sculpting product
reviews.x: The matte sculpting trio is my daily go-to product. It does such a beautiful job of contouring my face, I don't even use blush anymore - I just let this bring my cheekbones out, brush a little highlight on the top, and it looks very natural and pretty.

reviews.t: Top 3 Contour for Ghostly Pale Skin

It edges towards a slightly purple/grey taupe without being so purple/grey that I have to be careful.  It goes on sheer,but really nicely pigmented. reviews.t: Awesome just for the highlighter alone!

The product is easy to get off of the palette, and distributes easily on the face. It also feels nice, and leaves your face with a glittery glow. reviews.t: Great product for subtle contouring/highlighting
reviews.x: I like this product for subtle contouring and highlighting. I think it's great for the money, doesn't cake or crease, is lightweight, and easy to apply and blend. My only issue is it doesn't last all day. It's possible if you used a setting spray or something over it, it may last longer, but I haven't tried that. I still like to use it regularly though.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the palette for blending well and looking natural, especially for contouring.
Many reviewers with fair or pale skin find the shades work well for them, though some pale-skinned users report the colors are too light, too dark, or too orange.
Several reviewers mention the included brush is not useful and prefer to use their own.
A few reviewers report packaging or shipping problems, including shattered or spilled highlighter.
Some reviewers note the product does not last all day or has fallout.
